$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: digestion
title: digestion.tsv
description: Digestion summary: one row per searched file, then a `total` row. Also written to run-summary.json under qc.digestion.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Spectrum file name, or `total` for the final row covering all files.

fields.name: target_peptides
fields.description: Distinct target peptide sequences among rank-1 PSMs at 1% spectrum and peptide q-value.

fields.name: decoy_peptides
fields.description: Distinct decoy peptide sequences passing the same filter.

fields.name: missed_cleavages_2_plus
fields.description: Peptides with two or more missed cleavages (decoy-corrected).

fields.name: semi_n
fields.description: Peptides with a ragged (non-enzymatic) N-terminus only (decoy-corrected).

fields.name: semi_c
fields.description: Peptides with a ragged (non-enzymatic) C-terminus only (decoy-corrected).

fields.name: non_enzymatic
fields.description: Peptides with neither terminus produced by the enzyme (decoy-corrected).

fields.name: missed_cleavage_pct
fields.description: Percent of peptides with at least one missed cleavage, three decimals.
